first.rationale: Activation and onboarding completion are both declining, making onboarding simplification the most directly relevant intervention for sustainable qualified revenue. Verify the archived signup and onboarding records because their prior lifts may not generalize to the current decline or preserve downstream qualification. Run a guarded test measuring activation, time-to-value, qualified pipeline, and retention—not completion alone.

final.rationale: Run a segmented onboarding simplification experiment focused on SMB accounts, where signup simplification previously increased activation 9% and qualified revenue 4%, while shortened onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, and retention. Measure qualified revenue, activation, completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention; guard against repeating the observed 1% retention decline from signup simplification. This directly addresses both current activation and completion deterioration while preserving sustainable-revenue safeguards.
